results.investigation: B: CSS transition (transition: width 2s linear) — getComputedStyle during transition
results.conclusion: CONFIRMED: at 1 rAF getComputedStyle reports 100px (interpolated), not the settled 300px. assertApplied's single-rAF read would treat the mid-transition value as the result.

results.investigation: A: non-transitioned property (background) — is one rAF enough?
results.conclusion: One rAF is enough for a non-transitioned property (synchronous application).

results.investigation: C: transitionend reliability as the sync mechanism
results.conclusion: transitionend fires with the settled value (400px) — a bounded transitionend listener is a reliable sync.

results.investigation: D: FIX — patched assertApplied (waitForTransition) reads the SETTLED value during a transition
results.conclusion: PASS: fix reads 300px (≈ settled 300px); old read 400px was interpolated.
